snapshot.text: Public system expanding fast on oil revenue: the 2026 budget set aside $161 billion for modern hospitals, digital care and training thousands of health workers. A wave of new regional hospitals is opening.

priorities.title: New regional hospitals
priorities.text: New hospitals such as West Demerara are being built across the regions.

priorities.title: Training doctors and nurses
priorities.text: The ministry is ramping up training to staff the new hospitals.
